workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI bootstrap IAU candidate

publicIssue.title: Admit runtime settings CLI bootstrap IAU

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has explicit Prepare Local Runtime Settings CLI activation metadata but no public requirements import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, prepare-command handler shell, or public bootstrap/recovery contract.

splitDecision.reason: The prepare-command bootstrap shell is a smaller, reviewable unit than settings mutation or runtime validation. It can establish the terminal-surface contract without writing settings or executing runtime commands.

allowed: requirement IDs VHS-REQ-537, VHS-REQ-544, and VHS-REQ-594

prepare command returns or reports launcher materialization and recovery facts
runtime dependency and stale-launcher recovery are explicit
